data.one_liner: Pure Dart client for the Mistral AI API, supporting chat, embeddings, fine-tuning, agents, and more.
data.what_it_does: It provides a type‑safe, fully‑featured client for the Mistral AI API, including chat completions, streaming, embeddings, fine‑tuning, agents, and operational APIs. The client works on all Dart platforms without Flutter dependencies.
use_when: You need to integrate Mistral AI into a Dart or Flutter app
You want a fully typed client with streaming support
You prefer a pure Dart solution over HTTP wrappers
avoid_when: You only need a minimal HTTP client for a single endpoint
You are building a Flutter‑only UI that requires widget helpers
strengths: Full API coverage including beta features
Built‑in streaming, retries, and error handling
weaknesses: No Flutter widgets or UI helpers
Requires an API key and network access
Large feature set may be overkill for simple use cases
data.setup_notes: Add mistralai_dart to pubspec, set MISTRAL_API_KEY env var or pass key in code, then create MistralClient
